{{Quote|Thirty-two hours ago, thieves raided a military storehouse. They stole weapons, supplies and data files for the Planet Prison project.|Agent Galen|<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> during the [[Mission to Coruscant (Desolator crisis)|beginning]] of a [[Desolator crisis|crisis]] involving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and stolen [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Vistis Garn]] led [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] from the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] crime syndicate '''raided''' a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] [[Unidentified Republic Military warehouse|warehouse]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Garn had been hired by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate to break into the warehouse and led a team of three Rodians, three [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]], and an [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]]. Once in the warehouse, the thieves incapacitated the guards and stole a shipment of advanced [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]]. They also hacked the warehouse's systems and stole the design files for the [[Planet Prison]]<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> and other Republic superweapons.<ref name="Kidnapped!">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Kidnapped!|Coruscant}}</ref>

However, Garn's face was caught on a [[Security camera/Legends|security camera]] as they left, allowing the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]]&mdash;the Republic's intelligence agency&mdash;and the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] to track the group to the Guild-controlled [[Old Galactic Market]]. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] of the SIS then sent a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] to [[Raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|recover]] the files and weapons from the thieves in a [[Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|Guild warehouse]] there.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />

==Behind the scenes==
The raid was mentioned in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] mission "The Jedi Envoy" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where the event sets up the subsequent mission "Stolen Secrets."<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />
